checks.says: alerts.tsv names every open Dependabot alert and PR, each with a known action.
Every upgrade PR named is open against the default branch, or nothing was upgraded.
Every surface has a base result and every PR to merge was tested and listed for a person.

outcomes.name: upgrade breaks a surface
outcomes.says: A PR fails a live test that passes on the default branch.

checks.run: r=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2=="base" {b[$1]=$3} NR>1 && $2!="base" && $3=="fail" {f[$1]=1} END {for (s in f) if (b[s]=="pass") {print s; x=1}; exit !x}' .moor/artifacts/live.tsv) || exit 1; echo "fails only on a PR: $r"
checks.says: A surface passes on base and fails on a PR.

outcomes.name: upgrade PR ready
outcomes.says: An upgrade PR is open and failed no live test; a person merges it.

checks.says: No PR row in live.tsv is a fail.

outcomes.name: needs a person
outcomes.says: Open alerts, Dependabot PRs or base failures wait for a person.

checks.says: alerts.tsv has a row, or a base surface fails.

outcomes.name: all clear
outcomes.says: No open alerts, no upgrades, and every base surface passes or is n/a.
